_about: FluxCore ruleset v3: the generator as the Flux client implements it (spec 2.3, read from flux-ios). Replaces v1 for every new number; v1 stays as-is so the two regimes remain comparable, and v2 (the inverse-fitted weights) is superseded -- its fit was an artifact of running without the letter cap. Derived artifacts record the FNV-1a hash of this file's raw bytes. Keys beginning with '_' are comments.
_provisional: Server-side settings the client cannot show (spec 2.4): the per-tier candidate counts, how N is drawn inside them, whether the longest seed length is Spam-only, and the seed-length weights (the client port draws uniformly). Everything else in this file is confirmed from client code and checked against the 9,034 real boards.
_letterWeights: Spec 2.3, confirmed: the client's letterFrequencies table (flux-ios@fa8fb2d BoardUtils.swift), restated as the server's LETTER_FREQ in @525c64b LabBoardGenerator.swift. Standard English running-text frequency, x100 so the integers carry the table exactly (sums to 9,999). A weighted distribution, not dice. The client's variety adjustment raises these to a power; at variety 0.5 the power is 1, which is what this file encodes.
_generation: Spec 2.3, confirmed from flux-ios BoggleGenerator.swift (@fa8fb2d) and SinglePlayerHomeView.swift. maxPerLetter 2: a hard cap during the fill -- a letter at 2 copies drops out and the rest renormalize -- and no seed word over the cap is ever drawn; all 9,034 real boards have a maximum letter count of exactly 2. fillOrder random: the client fills the remaining cells in uniformly random order. seedScope perBoard: one seed decision and one seed word per board, drawn before best-of-N, shared by every candidate. seedPlacement randomWalk: the client's generateRandomPath. candidateDraw uniformQuality: the client computes N = floor(quality^2), and the published counts are squares (144 = 12^2, 625 = 25^2, 81 = 9^2), so quality is the uniform variable and N is not uniform. Which variable the server draws uniformly is not visible; this is the provisional reading.
_dictionary: Spec 2.1: CSW21 (279,496) minus the 419 words Flux removed (data/flux_removed_words.txt) = 279,077, the client's word_list.json exactly; then minus the 55,584 words that need 3+ copies of one letter and so can never have a path under maxPerLetter 2 = 223,493. Built with: build_dawg bogwords.txt flux_capped.dawg --exclude data/flux_removed_words.txt --max-letter-repeat 2. Every tool refuses any other DAWG.
_scoreTable: Spec 2.2, confirmed (flux-ios@3a8e30c; all 18,068 real player scores reproduce from it). n >= 6 is 400(n-3) + 200.
_seeding: Spec 2.3: 50% of boards carry one secret seed. pathAttempts is the client's walk restart budget (maxAttempts 1000); placementAttempts is 1 because the client calls generateRandomPath once and, with the seed laid first on an empty board, a found path always fits.
_cheapScoring: Off, as in v1. The v1 agreement measurement (99.90% at 1.48x) was made on uncapped boards and would have to be re-measured before turning it on here.
_grids: Spec 2.3 / 2.5: the current regime (seasons 3+) is 60/40, tiers 20/50/30 (confirmed from in-app text), seed lengths 8-11 on 4x4 and 9-13 on 5x5 (confirmed from the server port). Candidate counts as published; unconfirmed. The longest length stays Spam-only as in v1 so that only the confirmed corrections separate v1 from v3; the port draws uniformly over the whole range, which is still open (spec 2.4).
